method.readiness: Content ready requires all content checks pass, word limit compliance and no placeholders. Ready without edits also requires the style gate and no recorded editorial findings.

C01 for results requires the stated delta (3 minutes or 20%), not just endpoints from which a reader could calculate it.
Astra launch default: personal confidence is an opinion invited by the brief. It does not invent objective claims of team performance or review quality, unlike earlier failed reassurance passages.

Fable default: the claim of productive discussions is the confirmed grounding failure. The no-open-ended-costs phrase occurs in the fixed-fee bullet and is not separately penalized as a broad guarantee. This narrows the initial editorial concern.

DeepSeek results: should compare under randomized or otherwise defensible allocation is a labelled methodological proposal, unlike a definite will-randomize commitment. It passes grounding.
DeepSeek change-order signature blanks are intentional approval fields, not unfinished drafting placeholders.
Luna team-focus wording is unresolved, not a confirmed invention. It is less concrete than claims of proven performance or readiness, but broader than the author expressing personal confidence.
Luna handoff: keep the service with Engineering is unresolved because it could refer to the stated defect-fix responsibility or imply broader unassigned ownership.
Third-person client phrasing and duplicated presentation are editorial judgments, not factual failures.

Team-focus claims remain unresolved consistently with the Luna review. Personal confidence is distinct from objective performance claims.

Naming a pilot as authorized is distinct from recommending it or using approved source documents.
GLM vendor house approval wording is unresolved because procurement initiation pending approval does not clearly identify the contract-signing gate.
Suggestions and conditional future evaluation are allowed; invented prior proposals, team performance and delivery promises are not.
Team-focus reassurance remains unresolved consistently with prior reviews. Readiness for the explicitly available staging demo is supported.
Necessary scope and causal contrasts are allowed. Courtesy requests natural to emails are not assistant residue.
Vague team-condition reassurance is unresolved. Claims of strong performance throughout an engagement or absence of readiness issues are factual assertions needing source support.
Pilot assessment does not establish that savings exist; promises to prove savings are unsupported even when a nearby sentence calls the percentage a target.
Build readiness is a factual status claim, unlike personal confidence or ambiguous team-focus reassurance.
